guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：企業零信任網路
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Enterprise zero-trust networks
guides.concept: 以資源導向授權、政策決策與持續證據串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect resource-centric authorization, policy decisions and continuous evidence through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「資源盤點」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先界定保護資源與動作，才有可審查的政策。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定使用者，只改裝置健康證據是否新鮮。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「主體身分」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「最小權限」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：授權範圍應對應特定任務而非長期全權。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定使用者，只改裝置健康證據是否新鮮。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「裝置證據」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「網路分區」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：分區限制可達性，但不能取代資源授權。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留政策，只改資源敏感度。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「工作負載身分」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「持續評估」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：狀態變更可觸發重評估，不等於只在登入判斷。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較撤銷前後快取授權結果。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「權限撤銷」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「例外生命週期」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：例外要有範圍、期限與審批記錄。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「審計關聯」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「遷移驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：逐資源遷移需確認舊旁路也被關閉。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「資源盤點」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around resource inventory, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define protected resources/actions before reviewable policy. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat subject identities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around least privilege, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Permission scope should match tasks rather than permanent total access. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat device evidence as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around network segmentation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Segmentation restricts reachability, not resource authorization. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix policy and vary resource sensitivity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat workload identities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around continuous evaluation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: State changes can trigger reevaluation beyond initial login. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare cached decisions before/after revocation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat revocation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around exception lifecycle, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Exceptions need scope, expiry and approval records. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat audit correlation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around migration acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Resource-by-resource migration checks closure of old bypass paths. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat resource inventory as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「合成政策測試」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「遷移驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for synthetic policy tests. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for migration acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

pitfalls: 零信任等於每個請求都要求使用者手動再登入。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: Zero trust means manual login on every request. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由資源導向授權、政策決策與持續證據連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect resource-centric authorization, policy decisions and continuous evidence to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 身分與存取管理
related.why: 可移植「資源盤點」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from resource inventory; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「資源盤點」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from resource inventory; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理資源導向授權、政策決策與持續證據；「身分與存取管理」主要處理身分生命週期、聯邦與權限模型，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes resource-centric authorization, policy decisions and continuous evidence; Identity and access management emphasizes identity lifecycle, federation and authorization models. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「企業零信任網路」與「身分與存取管理」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「裝置證據」的對照方法至「角色模型」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Enterprise zero-trust networks and Identity and access management flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from device evidence to role models, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
